task.description:
WF-02 Step 03 (TEST-DESIGNER) for GRD-UI Batch 19.

The implementation already includes the guard spec files as the primary tests (meta-control.spec.ts, source-scan.spec.ts, bundle-scan.spec.ts). Your job is to:

1. Verify that all MUST acceptance criteria from GRD-UI-02, GRD-UI-03, GRD-UI-04, GRD-UI-05 are covered by the existing guard spec files
2. Add any missing test coverage as additional tests in `web/tests/unit/guardReporter.test.ts`:
   - Test writeViolations() output contains { file, line, patternName } and does NOT contain matched text
   - Test assertRedacted() throws when output contains credential-like strings
   - Test PATTERNS entries all have both offender and bystander fixtures

3. Commit if any new tests are added: git commit -m 'test(frontend): GRD-UI-05 reporter unit tests + guard AC coverage verification'
   git push origin feature/WF02-grd-ui-batch19-20260813

Return PASS when all MUST ACs are covered.
acceptance_criteria: All MUST ACs from GRD-UI-02..05 verified to be covered
writeViolations output format tested (no matched text)
Any new tests committed and pushed if added

result.summary: GRD-UI-02..05 MUST ACs verified covered by existing guard specs. Added web/tests/unit/guardReporter.test.ts with 10 unit tests: TC-GR-01..02 (writeViolations output format), TC-GR-03..08 (assertRedacted throws on extra keys carrying credential strings matching /sk-|password|token/i), TC-GR-09..10 (PATTERNS structure). All 16 test files / 73 tests pass. Committed 847f0967 and pushed to feature/WF02-grd-ui-batch19-20260813.
